title: Fill in Collective Nouns in Sentences

instruction.text: Choose the correct collective noun to complete the sentence.

atoms.sound: ssml: She bought a, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, of roses.
atoms.b: She bought a ((++bouquet team)) of roses.
atoms.finishSound: She bought a bouquet of roses.

atoms.sound: ssml: The other, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, won the game.
atoms.b: The other ((++team pile)) won the game.
atoms.finishSound: The other team won the game.

atoms.sound: ssml: A, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, of ships can be seen from the coast.
atoms.b: A ((++fleet crowd)) of ships can be seen from the coast.
atoms.finishSound: A fleet of ships can be seen from the coast.

atoms.sound: ssml: The, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, were very helpful.
ssml: I saw a, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, of wolves.
atoms.b: I saw a ((++pack fleet)) of wolves.
atoms.finishSound: I saw a pack of wolves.
